summary: A MOD and XM tracker for writing, playing and saving FastTracker 2 and ProTracker songs on the FM-1, with a browser song manager for moving files to and from a computer.
features: Up to 32 channels; FastTracker 2 replayer and a ProTracker mode
Pattern editor showing 4 or 8 channels, with blocks and undo
Instrument volume and panning envelopes, sample loops and finetune
Up to 32 songs in flash; first save overwrites other firmwares' data
USB MIDI clock out, transport in, and USB audio input
Untested on official firmware V16's boot loader
